summary.text: Matthew Rohrbach is a Republican physician and member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 26, where he has served since 2015, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Matthew Rohrbach was born in Huntington, West Virginia, and earned a bachelor's degree and a medical degree from Marshall University.
He completed his medical internship at the University of Tennessee, his residency at the University of Kentucky and a fellowship at East Tennessee State University, and has worked as a physician.
Rohrbach's committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session were Finance, Health and Human Resources Accountability, Rules, and Senior, Children, and Family Issues.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
